questions.q: If A can do a piece of work in 10 days and B can do the same work in 15 days, how many days will they take to complete the work together?
questions.h: Find individual daily efficiencies and add them to get combined efficiency.
questions.s: A's one day work is 1/10 and B's one day work is 1/15. Together, their one day work is (1/10 + 1/15) = (3/30 + 2/30) = 5/30 = 1/6. Therefore, they will complete the work in 6 days. Final answer: 6 days
